text: OVERDOSAGE The treatment of overdose is essentially symptomatic and supportive. The stomach should be emptied promptly by lavage or by induction of emesis (syrup of ipecac recommended). The installation of activated charcoal into the stomach also should be considered. If respiratory depression is present, treat promptly with oxygen and/or mechanical support of ventilation. If convulsions or marked CNS excitement occurs, only short acting benzodiazepine-type drugs should be used.
